# AI Recruitment and Candidate Ranking System

## System Purpose

The system assists HR teams during recruitment by analysing candidate profiles and ranking applicants according to job-related criteria.

The system does not make the final hiring decision. HR staff review the generated recommendations before deciding whether to proceed with or reject a candidate.

## Intended Users

The intended users are:

- HR staff
- Recruitment managers
- Hiring managers

## Personal Data

The system processes personal data provided by applicants, including:

- education
- professional experience
- skills
- employment history
- application documents

Sensitive personal data is not intentionally used for candidate ranking.

## Automated Decision Support

The system automatically generates candidate rankings and recommendation scores.

These rankings are used as decision-support information for HR staff.

## Risk Management

A documented risk management process is maintained throughout the lifecycle of the system.

The process includes:

- identification of reasonably foreseeable risks
- evaluation of potential impacts on applicants
- mitigation measures
- testing before deployment
- periodic review after deployment

Risk controls are reviewed whenever major changes are made to the system.

## Data Governance

Training, validation and testing datasets are documented.

The datasets are reviewed for:

- relevance
- representativeness
- completeness
- data quality
- potential bias

Known data-quality issues are documented and corrective measures are applied before model deployment.

## Technical Documentation

Technical documentation is maintained for the system.

The documentation includes:

- intended purpose
- system architecture
- model design
- data sources
- validation procedures
- known limitations
- risk controls
- human-oversight measures
- accuracy metrics

The documentation is reviewed when the system is updated.

## Record Keeping and Logging

The system automatically records:

- generated rankings
- prediction timestamps
- user actions
- overridden recommendations
- administrative changes
- important system events

Logs are retained for audit and monitoring purposes.

## Transparency

HR staff are informed that rankings are generated by an AI system.

The interface provides information about:

- the purpose of the system
- important limitations
- confidence information
- factors relevant to generated recommendations

HR staff are instructed not to rely solely on AI-generated rankings.

## Human Oversight

Human oversight is assigned to trained HR staff.

HR staff:

- review AI-generated recommendations
- understand the main system limitations
- monitor for unusual outputs
- are trained regarding automation bias
- can disregard an AI recommendation
- can override a ranking
- can stop use of the system when necessary

No candidate is automatically hired or rejected solely on the basis of the AI output.

## Accuracy and Robustness

The system is evaluated using documented accuracy metrics before deployment.

Performance is periodically monitored after deployment.

Robustness testing is performed for:

- incomplete input data
- unusual candidate profiles
- system failures
- unexpected model behaviour

## Cybersecurity

The system uses:

- authentication
- role-based access control
- encryption
- security logging
- restricted administrative access

Security incidents are monitored and documented.

## Monitoring

The operation of the system is monitored after deployment.

Detected issues, unexpected performance and serious incidents are documented and reviewed.

Corrective actions are taken when necessary.
